Fixed World Day of Social Justice
Rule.comment: Proclaimed by the United Nations General Assembly in 2007 (resolution 62/10) and first observed on 20 February 2009, to acknowledge that social development and social justice are indispensable to peace and security.

Rule.name: Fixed World Day Against Child Labour
Rule.comment: Launched by the International Labour Organization (ILO) in 2002 to raise awareness and action to combat child labour and to improve working conditions.

Rule.name: Fixed Nelson Mandela International Day
Rule.comment: Proclaimed by the United Nations General Assembly in 2009 (resolution 64/13) and first observed on 18 July 2010, the anniversary of Nelson Mandela's birth, in recognition of his contribution to the culture of peace and freedom.

Rule.name: Fixed International Day of Charity
Rule.comment: Proclaimed by the United Nations General Assembly in 2012 (resolution 67/105) and first observed on 5 September 2013. The date marks the anniversary of the death of Mother Teresa of Calcutta in 1997.

NotableDate.name: International Day of the Girl Child

Rule.name: Fixed International Day of the Girl Child
Rule.comment: Proclaimed by the United Nations General Assembly in 2011 (resolution 66/170) and first observed on 11 October 2012, to recognise girls' rights and challenges faced by girls worldwide.

Rule.name: Fixed Universal Children's Day
Rule.comment: Established by the United Nations General Assembly in 1954 (resolution 836(IX)) to promote international togetherness, awareness among children worldwide, and improving children's welfare. The date also marks the adoption of the Convention on the Rights of the Child in 1989.
